title: House with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- grass -->
  <rect x='0' y='82' width='100' height='18' fill='#3ec46d' rx='2'/>
  <!-- house body -->
  <rect x='22' y='42' width='56' height='42' fill='#f4b942' rx='3'/>
  <!-- house body lighter edge -->
  <rect x='22' y='42' width='56' height='42' fill='none' stroke='#ffd76e' stroke-width='2' rx='3'/>
  <!-- roof -->
  <polygon points='16,44 50,14 84,44' fill='#e05a4e'/>
  <polygon points='16,44 50,14 84,44' fill='none' stroke='#ff8a7a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- door -->
  <rect x='42' y='62' width='16' height='22' fill='#7b4b2a' rx='2'/>
  <rect x='42' y='62' width='16' height='22' fill='none' stroke='#b07a4f' stroke-width='2' rx='2'/>
  <!-- doorknob -->
  <circle cx='55' cy='74' r='1.8' fill='#ffd76e'/>
  <!-- smiling eyes -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='54' r='3.5' fill='#2d3a8c'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='54' r='3.5' fill='#2d3a8c'/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx='37.3' cy='52.8' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='65.3' cy='52.8' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M38 60 Q50 70 62 60' fill='none' stroke='#2d3a8c' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- windows -->
  <rect x='27' y='66' width='10' height='10' fill='#8fd4f4' rx='1.5'/>
  <rect x='27' y='66' width='10' height='10' fill='none' stroke='#c9eeff' stroke-width='2' rx='1.5'/>
  <rect x='63' y='66' width='10' height='10' fill='#8fd4f4' rx='1.5'/>
  <rect x='63' y='66' width='10' height='10' fill='none' stroke='#c9eeff' stroke-width='2' rx='1.5'/>
  <!-- window crossbars -->
  <line x1='32' y1='66' x2='32' y2='76' stroke='#c9eeff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='27' y1='71' x2='37' y2='71' stroke='#c9eeff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='68' y1='66' x2='68' y2='76' stroke='#c9eeff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='63' y1='71' x2='73' y2='71' stroke='#c9eeff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- chimney -->
  <rect x='66' y='20' width='8' height='18' fill='#c0453b' rx='1'/>
  <rect x='66' y='20' width='8' height='18' fill='none' stroke='#f07a6e' stroke-width='2' rx='1'/>
  <!-- smoke -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='14' r='3' fill='#d8e6f0' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='9' r='2.2' fill='#d8e6f0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='5' r='1.6' fill='#d8e6f0' opacity='0.55'/>
</svg>
